name: Bayside Internet
summary: Gold Coast dialup + ISDN + ADSL ISP (operated by Female Technologies); retail Bayside Internet homepage last seen Jan 2006, then rebranded to The Femtech Group; bayside.net.au later reused by Network Voice and Data.

events.details: Earliest Wayback capture 14 Apr 1997 (bayside.net.au); footer ACN 078668505 (Queensland Internet Services) incorporated 14 May 1997; ISDN link up.
Retail 'Welcome to Bayside Internet' homepage last archived Jan 2006; site rebranded to The Femtech Group (same operator, Female Technologies) by Feb 2007.
bayside.net.au later reused by Network Voice and Data (Tropical North Queensland IT supplier), unrelated to the original Gold Coast ISP.
